body:
GET/PUT /api/v1/mailing-list/settings/mailchimp, gated behind new mailinglist.admin permission (super_admin), distinct from mailinglist.export. New mailchimp_settings table (encrypted, same posture as subscriber emails). resolveMailchimpClient: stored settings win when vault unlocked, falls back to env-var-configured client otherwise -- MailchimpClient itself needed zero redesign. subscribe() now goes through this resolver. 9 new tests, go test ./... clean. Live-verified against prod var/iduna.db + var/mailinglist.db, redeployed iduna.service. Commit 534dd12. Unblocks S245-04's settings UI.

⚓ ☃
title: S245-03: real per-instance, admin-configurable Mailchimp settings
